_what: Evangelical share of the DOXA people groups' POPULATION, for the packet's life-calendar page.
_method: Each group's published EvangelicalLevel BAND is taken at its midpoint (0 for 'No Known Evangelicals'), weighted by the group's Population, and summed. peoplegroups.org publishes a band, never a number, so a percentage requires choosing a value inside each band; the midpoint is stated on the page itself.
_join: IMB CSV ROP3Code + ISOAlpha3 against doxa-groups-snapshot.json rop3 + country — the same join the Vision Card uses (build-lists.mjs:13).
